source_functions: registered @dataset_cleaner functions for UNSDG_CWUEFF, UNSDG_WTSTRS, UNSDG_WUSEFF (Mongo handles stubbed)

variants.name: fixture_as_committed
variants.note: Singapore now reports water-use efficiency from 2005, so the derived CWUEFF exists for SGP and the route's unconditional SGP reference-class series duplicates it; the legacy impute route raises on current source data (WATMAN-3).

variants.name: sgp_without_2005
variants.note: Singapore's single baseline-period value (2005, TOTAL activity) blanked, which is the source state the route was written against: SGP has WUSEFF rows but no CWUEFF, receives the reference-class series, and CHE (listed) receives the synthetic series.
